input.summary: Rename via PATCH is implemented correctly: only title is copied (no mass assignment), blank or non-string titles give 400, unknown id gives 404, and an empty body still toggles. Tests cover every acceptance criterion. No blocking issues.

artifacts.title: Review: Rename a todo
artifacts.markdown:
Ready for QA. The diff matches the plan and all acceptance criteria. Mass assignment is avoided and tests ship with the change.

1. (minor, non-blocking) The `body && typeof body === "object"` guard is slightly redundant given the `readJson` type, but it protects against a raw `null` body, so keep it.
2. Cross-ticket: EV0XEBCZ-2 adds `dueDate` to Todo. The tests here use `{ ...todo, title }`, so they survive. The adjacent edits in todos.ts, server.ts and the test files are in different regions. EV0XEBCZ-1 edits `remove`, just below `rename`, and should merge trivially.

crossTicketRisks.description: Both edit src/todos.ts and test/todos.test.ts in adjacent hunks (rename vs remove); trivial merge.

Both edit src/todos.ts, src/server.ts and the test files in different regions. Server tests here use spread, so they tolerate dueDate. The rename test in test/todos.test.ts may deepEqual on {id,title,done} and would need dueDate: null after merge.
